answer: Attestation depth scoring at the grove: each identity's trust score is the shortest path of mutual attestations from the seed set. The island of isolated keys never links in, capping sybils at depth 0. Forging depth requires real vouches at jade cost — roughly 3 honest attestations per identity, so a farm of n costs O(n log n) real social ties, not free keys. Latency-bounded propagation keeps scoring under 200ms. Works because fake depth can't be bought cheaper than genuine trust.
